title: Verify: Export JSON shape and docs unit tests
summary: Unit tests for Export JSON keys and doc comments
description: Write export_test.go asserting marshalled keys, RFC3339 time and doc comments on the types.
acceptance_criteria: Marshalled Export has version, world_id, round_id, contributions
Each contribution has id, author, content, created_at

steps.action: Marshal Export{Version: ExportVersion, WorldID: "w", RoundID: "ROUND-0000001", Contributions: one ExportContribution with ID CON-1, Author p1, Content hi, CreatedAt 2026-01-02T03:04:05Z}; unmarshal into map[string]any and assert keys version, world_id, round_id, contributions and the four contribution keys, and created_at equals "2026-01-02T03:04:05Z".
Use go/parser with parser.ParseComments on export.go and assert the GenDecls for Export and ExportContribution have non-empty Doc.
